$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-input for Input and Input Group, .ds-field for Field) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: The side padding sits on .ds-input__control (Body), not on the box. Field root (a column with an 8 px gap) is covered by its size and the pixels.

Body.$why: The control also holds the inline text (L slot / T slot), so it is wider than Figma's Body.

L slot.$why: The slot's 10 px edge distance is a margin on the text in code; the pixels cover the position.
